'''Magnus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[O'reenian]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who overthrew the [[Unidentified Republic bureaucrat's son|leader]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[O'reen]] in a bloodless coup d'état. The new government with the support of the populace instituted new reforms in [[O'reenian]] society that emphasized military-style discipline and training for the citizens. The ruler's name eventually became the title [[Magnus (title)|Magnus]], used by all subsequent rulers of O'reen.<ref name="UR 178">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
